exercise_answer_set.printed_figure: LUYỆN TẬP 1 draws a 4-slot timeline: row «Sự kiện» = [Khởi nghĩa Hai Bà Trưng] [?] [?] [?]; row «Thời gian» = [40 – 43] [?] [?] [938].
exercise_answer_set.finding: The book gives slot 1 (event + years) and slot 4 (year 938 only) and leaves the two middle slots and slot 4's event name open. The prose lists SEVEN candidate events. The SGK therefore does NOT state a unique answer set for this exercise — any grader that scored the middle slots would be inventing one.
exercise_answer_set.consequence: TimelineValidator may check ORDER over the events the book states; it may NOT grade LUYỆN TẬP 1.
